title: Pain Management for Cystoscopy: A Prospective Randomized Study Focused on Understanding the Role of the "Bag Squeeze" to Manage Pain for Patients Undergoing Cystoscopy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether utilization of the "bag squeeze" technique during flexible cystoscopy changes pain scores using a study questionnaire designed by the team which comprises a validated Lingard pain rating scale.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male
* Undergoing flexible cystocopy at University Health Network that have undergone a flexible cystocopy and did not demonstrate difficulty during exploration (meatal stenosis or urethral stricture), simultaneous removal or ureteral stents or bladder biopsies or have a chronic history of pelvic pain

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Patients that do not meet the inclusion criteria.
